test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentences in correct order to make a meaningful passage
1. The compiled dossier is submitted to the inter-ministerial review desk.
2. Algorithmic screening filters inconsistencies within submitted declarations.
3. Field-level reports are aggregated at the nodal coordination center.
4. Structured summaries are generated post-filtering.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentences describe a procedural workflow involving data aggregation, filtering, and submission.
 
• **Sentence 3** is the first step as it describes the collection of field-level reports:
 
 
• "Field-level reports are aggregated at the nodal coordination center."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 2** comes next, where algorithmic screening filters inconsistencies in the submitted declarations:
 
 
• "Algorithmic screening filters inconsistencies within submitted declarations."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4** follows as structured summaries are generated post-filtering:
 
 
• "Structured summaries are generated post-filtering."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1** is the final step, where the compiled dossier is submitted to the inter-ministerial review desk:
 
 
• "The compiled dossier is submitted to the inter-ministerial review desk."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **3-2-4-1**.

 

**Coherent passage after rearrangement**:

"Field-level reports are aggregated at the nodal coordination center. Algorithmic screening filters inconsistencies within submitted declarations. Structured summaries are generated post-filtering. The compiled dossier is submitted to the inter-ministerial review desk."</div
